what: per-species growth delta(0)/delta(1000) at k = 0.15 h/Mpc vs CAMB 2.0.5
reading: The baryon sector is the outlier: its growth ratio is 1.49x CAMB while CDM is only 1.09x. At z=1000 our baryon/CDM ratio is 0.044 against CAMB's 0.060, i.e. 27% low -- the baryon perturbation is under-grown through the acoustic/decoupling epoch and then has to catch up. Photon and neutrino entries read 1.000 exactly because when RSA is on those state rows are frozen (dY=0); the recorded value is the stale state, not the RSA value used in the sources.
